featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.nri_angle: The viral moment reflects a deeply Indian travel tradition — packing ghar ka khana for every journey. For the diaspora, the steel thali and Amul dahi packet are instantly recognizable cultural markers, evoking memories of family trips and home-cooked meals that no airline menu can replace.

just_in.nri_angle: Founded by IIT Bombay alumni, InspeCity represents India's growing claim in the global space economy. Its success signals that deep-tech hardware startups incubated at Indian institutions can compete with international players like Astroscale and Northrop Grumman.

news.title: India's Homegrown CAR-T Cell Therapies Are Reshaping Blood Cancer Treatment
news.excerpt: With two approved indigenous CAR-T therapies and over 600 patients treated, India has emerged as a global hub for affordable cell and gene therapy — at one-tenth the cost of Western alternatives.

immigration.title: DHS Revives Plan to End Work Permits for Spouses of H-1B Workers
immigration.excerpt: The regulatory agenda entry signals renewed intent to roll back the 2015 H-4 EAD rule, but the multi-step rulemaking process means no immediate changes for current holders.
immigration.image_caption: The Department of Homeland Security has added a proposal to its 2026 regulatory agenda to remove H-4 dependent spouses from the classes of noncitizens eligible for employment authorization.
immigration.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of Indian spouses rely on H-4 EADs to work while their families face decade-long green card backlogs, making this proposal a direct threat to diaspora household incomes.

immigration.excerpt: The first state-funded program of its kind provides free legal help to all California community college students and their families, with demand nearly doubling as immigration enforcement intensifies.
immigration.image_caption: California's community college system. The state's Find Your Ally program offers free immigration legal assistance to all 2.1 million students across 116 community colleges.

immigration.title: Indian Student Applications to U.S. Colleges Drop 15% as Visa Rules Tighten

immigration.image_caption: Indian student applications to U.S. colleges have dropped 15 percent as tightening visa rules and policy uncertainty discourage prospective applicants.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian families — the largest international student demographic on U.S. campuses — face a fundamentally altered landscape as visa caps, potential OPT fees, and H-1B restrictions force a recalculation of whether an American degree remains worth the investment.

immigration.title: ICE Arrests Soar to Nearly 50,000 in July, Highest Monthly Total of Trump Era
immigration.excerpt: A strategic shift to lower-profile enforcement across airports, courthouses, and traffic stops drove a 15 percent surge in arrests, backed by billions in new funding and 12,000 new officers.
immigration.image_caption: An ICE officer oversees an immigration enforcement operation. ICE arrests reached nearly 50,000 in July, the highest monthly total of the Trump era.
immigration.nri_angle: The broadened ICE enforcement scope — including arrests at scheduled check-ins, airports, and traffic stops — carries heightened risk for Indian and South Asian immigrants holding work visas, pending asylum claims, or TPS designations.

travel.nri_angle: Air India cabin crew siblings from Manipur represent the people behind the uniforms on flights connecting India to the world — a human-interest story for diaspora travelers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India Weighs Mandatory Annual Drug Tests for All Pilots After Air India Marijuana Incident
travel.excerpt: Civil Aviation Minister says DGCA is consulting stakeholders on expanding pilot drug testing from 10 percent to 100 percent of the workforce annually.
travel.image_caption: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu addresses the media in New Delhi about proposed changes to pilot drug testing regulations. The DGCA is consulting stakeholders on expanding testing from 10 percent to 100 percent of pilots annually.
travel.nri_angle: The proposed expansion of pilot drug testing affects safety oversight on India-US routes operated by Air India, a critical concern for millions of diaspora travelers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Kerala Launches 'Be a Malayali for a Day' Campaign to Reinvent Tourism Around Experiences
travel.excerpt: The southern Indian state is shifting from scenic postcard marketing to immersive cultural tourism, with Onam festivities, backwater stays, and Ayurvedic retreats anchoring the new strategy.
travel.image_caption: A houseboat on Kerala's backwaters. The state has launched 'Be a Malayali for a Day,' a new experiential tourism campaign inviting visitors to participate in local traditions.
travel.nri_angle: NRI Malayalis and second-generation diaspora can reconnect with their heritage through curated cultural experiences during visits home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: DHS Revives Plan to End Work Permits for Spouses of H-1B Workers
carousel.excerpt: The regulatory agenda entry signals renewed intent to roll back the 2015 H-4 EAD rule, but the multi-step rulemaking process means no immediate changes for current holders.
carousel.image_caption: The Department of Homeland Security has added a proposal to its 2026 regulatory agenda to remove H-4 dependent spouses from the classes of noncitizens eligible for employment authorization.
carousel.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of Indian spouses rely on H-4 EADs to work while their families face decade-long green card backlogs, making this proposal a direct threat to diaspora household incomes.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Rejects Hague Court Ruling on Indus Waters Treaty as 'Illegal'
carousel.excerpt: India has dismissed the Permanent Court of Arbitration's latest award on the Kishenganga and Ratle hydroelectric projects, calling the tribunal illegally constituted and its rulings void.
carousel.nri_angle: The dispute over the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty highlights the deep freeze in India-Pakistan relations and raises questions about the future of one of the world's oldest water-sharing agreements.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Yash's 'Toxic' Crosses Rs 200 Crore in India Net Collections by Day 5
carousel.excerpt: The gangster actioner directed by Geetu Mohandas has surpassed Rs 255 crore worldwide and continues its strong first-weekend run.
carousel.image_caption: Actor Yash at the Toxic trailer launch event. His latest film Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups has crossed Rs 200 crore in India net collections by its fifth day of release.
carousel.nri_angle: Yash's 'Toxic' extends Kannada cinema's growing pan-India and global footprint, building on the KGF franchise's international success.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Deepti Sharma Sets T20I Record as India Rout Thailand in Asia Cup Opener
carousel.excerpt: The veteran all-rounder claimed three wickets without conceding a run to become the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20 Internationals during India's dominant 94-run victory in Dubai.
carousel.image_caption: Deepti Sharma became the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20 International history during India's Asia Cup opener against Thailand.
carousel.nri_angle: Deepti Sharma's record-breaking achievement is a milestone for Indian cricket and a source of pride for the global Indian diaspora following women's cricket.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: IIT Gandhinagar Uses Machine Learning to Find Materials That Could Convert CO₂ Into Industrial Fuel
carousel.excerpt: Researchers screened 56 five-metal combinations using AI-accelerated simulations and identified three ultrathin catalysts that show promise for converting carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide without external electrical input.
carousel.nri_angle: The research at IIT Gandhinagar showcases India's growing role in AI-driven scientific discovery and climate technology, an area of increasing collaboration between Indian institutions and the global research community.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India's Economy Grows 7.8% in April-June, Beating All Forecasts
carousel.excerpt: GDP growth in Q1 FY2027 comfortably surpassed the 7.1% consensus and the RBI's 7% projection, driven by a surge in manufacturing and investment activity.
carousel.nri_angle: India's strong growth run — potentially the fourth consecutive year above 7% — could support equity markets and attract portfolio inflows, with implications for NRI investors.
